title: Agent Groups
subtitle: Manage groups for supervisor scope and people organisation

confirmDelete: Delete this group? This action cannot be undone.
noAdminToken: Admin token required. Please log in with an admin account.
membersHint: Add agent_type_ids that belong to this group. Mark as Human for human agent queues.
